title: Concept: Query plan returned in a response
description: An execution plan that names scans and indexes in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The plan names the tables and indexes the query touched, which is a schema map and a hint for building a slower, heavier query.
applicability: Deployments that render an execution plan that names scans and indexes into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The plan names the tables and indexes the query touched, which is a schema map and a hint for building a slower, heavier query.
